Portland Group Will Deliver Free Medical Marijuana To Qualifying Patients

Medicinal Marijuana Deliveries

PORTLAND, OR -- A brand new non-profit group based in Portland will deliver free marijuana cigarettes to qualifying patients within a 60-block radius. All they’ll pay for is the cost of delivery... ten-dollars for 40- blocks, twelve-dollars for 60-blocks. The members of "Karma Geaea" (GAY-uh), or "Gifts of the Earth," all use aliases. Spokesman "Jolly Dodger" says of their five customers so far, two have AIDS, three have cancer. He says he knows he’s taking a chance as rules for the new Oregon law have not been finalized.
See

and

Before Cooperating With Patients Under New State Medical Marijuana Law,
Defeating Purpose of Initiative
And he won’t say where he gets the pot.
(Marijuananews note: I am frequently asked if I know where persons needing medical marijuana can get a safe supply. I do not, and – sadly -- I could not give out the information over the Net if I did. People in the Portland area might try calling Oregonians for Medical Rights. There toll-free number is (877) 600-6767.)
